description: Données VELOPOP' temps réel sur l'agglomération du Grand Avignon - Velos électriques en libre service is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grand Avignon. Données au format gbfs concernant les vélos électriques en libre service sur le territoire du Grand Avignon. Coverage: Grand Avignon. The publisher named on the listing is Grand Avignon. The listing shows 2025-08-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
